Companion Animal Travel Desk: welcome and why it matters

This page gives you the basics for helping pet travelers at Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is where careful planning meets calm service, so the goal is to keep every animal safe and every passenger informed. When a traveler arrives with a pet, listen first, check the travel papers, and guide them through the required steps without rushing. Clear explanations ease stress for both people and animals, and steady attention helps prevent small issues from becoming big ones.

As a records aide, you will help track what the passenger coordinator has confirmed and what the boarding team still needs. Keep notes neat, use the approved forms, and speak in simple language. If a pet seems uneasy, stay patient and let the trained staff handle the direct care while you support the process from the desk. That calm handoff is part of good service.

For Cloudrest, the pet cabin is maintained as listed in the current service record. <<FACT F040>> Keep the traveler updated in plain terms, and make sure the record matches what the flight team needs before departure.

For Moonwake, follow the boarding guidance exactly as filed. <<FACT F054>> Also note the pet area reference for that service so the right staff can guide the handoff. <<FACT F048>> If a detail is unclear, check the file before you speak, because accuracy protects the animal and keeps the journey smooth.

Remember to stay calm, check the file, and protect the pet's comfort.
